units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Heading naming Solomon, the book's purposes (1:2-6) and its motto, the fear of the LORD (1:7).

roles_chirho.role_chirho: Solomon son of David, king of Israel
roles_chirho.text_facts_chirho: named as the source of the proverbs (1:1)

art_choices_chirho: any depiction of Solomon writing or teaching is a framing choice; the verse is a heading

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Opening appeal to heed father and mother; their teaching is a garland and a chain (1:9).

roles_chirho.text_facts_chirho: her law (teaching) is named, 1:8; she does not speak

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: The gang's invitation is quoted as one speech (1:11-14): ambush the innocent, share one purse.

roles_chirho.text_facts_chirho: a group who entice the son, plan to lie in wait for blood (1:11)
the intended victim of the ambush, hypothetical (1:11)

art_choices_chirho: number, ages and dress of the gang
the road or place of the ambush
units_chirho.uncertainty_chirho: The ambush is the gang's proposal inside the father's warning, not a narrated event.

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: The father's answer: avoid their path; they lie in wait for their own blood (1:18).
units_chirho.uncertainty_chirho: The bird and net (1:17) is a comparison, not a scene element.

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Personified Wisdom raises her voice in public places and calls the simple and scoffers to turn.

roles_chirho.text_facts_chirho: feminine ('she'), cries aloud in the street, squares, gate openings (1:20-21)

art_choices_chirho: Wisdom shown as a woman follows the text's personification; her face, age and clothes are art choices

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Because they refused, she will laugh at their calamity; distress comes like a storm and whirlwind (1:27).

roles_chirho.text_facts_chirho: they will call and not be answered (1:28)

units_chirho.uncertainty_chirho: The storm and whirlwind are comparisons for coming calamity.

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Consequences: the complacent destroyed; whoever listens dwells safely (1:33).
units_chirho.title_chirho: The end of the two paths
